operations.description:
The BatchCreateTableRows API allows you to create one or more rows at the end of a table in a workbook. The API allows you to specify the values to set in some or all of the columns in the new rows.

If a column is not explicitly set in a specific row, then the column level formula specified in the table will be applied to the new row. If there is no column level formula but the last row of the table has a formula, then that formula will be copied down to the new row. If there is no column level formula and no formula in the last row of the table, then that column will be left blank for the new rows.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] batch create table rows [PATH] workbooks tables rows batchcreate [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers id security sha signature signed table token workbook x [SCHEMA] batch create created cursor data exceeded exception failed id input item items map quota result row rows service table workbook

operations.description: The BatchDeleteTableRows API allows you to delete one or more rows from a table in a workbook. You need to specify the ids of the rows that you want to delete from the table.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] batch delete table rows [PATH] workbooks tables rows batchdelete [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers id security sha signature signed table token workbook x [SCHEMA] batch cursor delete failed id item items result row rows table workbook

operations.description:
The BatchUpdateTableRows API allows you to update one or more rows in a table in a workbook.

You can specify the values to set in some or all of the columns in the table for the specified rows. If a column is not explicitly specified in a particular row, then that column will not be updated for that row. To clear out the data in a specific cell, you need to set the value as an empty string ("").
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] batch update table rows [PATH] workbooks tables rows batchupdate [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers id security sha signature signed table token workbook x [SCHEMA] batch cursor data failed id input item items result row rows table update workbook

operations.description:
The BatchUpsertTableRows API allows you to upsert one or more rows in a table. The upsert operation takes a filter expression as input and evaluates it to find matching rows on the destination table. If matching rows are found, it will update the cells in the matching rows to new values specified in the request. If no matching rows are found, a new row is added at the end of the table and the cells in that row are set to the new values specified in the request.

You can specify the values to set in some or all of the columns in the table for the matching or newly appended rows. If a column is not explicitly specified for a particular row, then that column will not be updated for that row. To clear out the data in a specific cell, you need to set the value as an empty string ("").
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] batch upsert table rows [PATH] workbooks tables rows batchupsert [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers id security sha signature signed table token workbook x [SCHEMA] batch cursor data exceeded exception failed filter id input item items map quota result row rows service table upsert workbook
